source: docs/adr/0004 - Secret Key length, rendering and checksum
note: Generated by an independent implementation (Python: Crockford base32 written from the specification, plus hashlib.sha256) so the Rust codec is checked against something that is not itself.
alphabet: Crockford base32, 0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ, no padding. Excludes I, L, O and U so that O normalises to 0 and I/L normalise to 1 with no ambiguity.
normalisation: On decode only: uppercase, strip hyphens and whitespace, O->0, I->1, L->1.
checksum: low 10 bits of SHA-256 over the 16 key bytes, big-endian: ((d[30] & 0x03) << 8) | d[31], rendered high-5-bits-first as two base32 characters
grouping: CHV1- then 7 groups of 4, hyphen-separated; display only, ignored on decode
canonical: The 26th character carries the key's last 3 bits and 2 padding bits, which must be zero.
